{{Quote|If you could tell him to contact me as soon as possible, I would be most grateful. Tell him it is urgent; there is a Lieutenant Ean who is under the impression that Major Pirrell is no longer serving on Balmorra and has begun clearing out his office and slated me for a memory wipe by the end of the week.|[[ODX-9]], to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:Hysmm" />}}
'''Ean''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. After Lieutenant [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Pirrell]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]], Ean was tasked with clearing out Pirrell's office and slated [[ODX-9]], Pirrell's secretary, for a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]].<ref name="TOR:Hysmm" />
